item.title: Thursday 1 PM Update, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: New York City conditions through tomorrow afternoon; GM's two-hundred-twenty-million-dollar driver-data settlement and the death of labor leader Dolores Huerta; Israel's count wraps up with no majority, Iran claims tankers hit mines near Hormuz, a container ship sinks after a drone attack off Bulgaria, and Yemen's hospitals buckle in Taiz; midday markets as Alphabet heads for its worst day on record while small caps rally; Alexa for Shopping takes over grocery lists; Anthropic's new Claude Enterprise tracking tools; a Linux flaw chained with the PHP2Shell attacks; your X feed; Sunset Park's Third Avenue redesign and record early voting; and the tallest mural in America. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: New York City conditions through tomorrow morning; Alaska's governor orders a probe of the spoiler-candidate allegations, and AP reports the U.S. warned allies to prepare for possible Iran strikes after the midterms; Israel's count of soldiers' and diplomats' ballots, the Dnipro toll rises, and Philippine-China friction at ASEAN defense talks; markets at the open after hotter inflation and stronger growth, Alphabet's plunge and the ECB on hold; Reddit's new For You feed and Nvidia's open transcription model; Google's Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defenders; a leak of DHS staff records and suspected hacking of base freezers; your X feed; a deadly Brooklyn crash as the city starts its Dusk and Darkness safety push; and a stranger's lunch gift in South Korea. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday Morning, Oct 29
item.description:
The Thursday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 29, 2026: the full New York City forecast with the week ahead; Judge Carter rejects the Justice Department's bid to set aside twenty thousand California ballots, and both parties make closing midterm pitches; Spain's train-crash toll rises to sixty-nine with focus on a control-center order, Israel awaits final results, Semafor reports parallel tracks of Iran diplomacy and post-midterm strike planning, a deadly Russian strike on Dnipro's train station, and Christine Lagarde's early exit from the ECB; markets in depth as Alphabet sinks and Microsoft rises ahead of inflation and GDP data; Anduril and Qualcomm's U.S.-assembled BlueChip laptop; OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra and Google DeepMind's Genie 4; Cisco's exploited firewall flaw, an attack on Alpine Linux's GitLab and GitHub's new npm firewall; your X feed; a deadly e-scooter fire in the Bronx, vandalism at the 9/11 Memorial and a huge weekend in the city; and a soup kitchen that opened a free dental clinic. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Wednesday 4 PM Update, Oct 28
item.description:
The Wednesday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 28, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow afternoon; hackers knock the FEC's campaign-finance filing system offline days before the midterms, and the President demands Mary Peltola be removed from Alaska's ballot; Cyclone Arnab hits India's east coast, Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami, and Europe's gas price tops one hundred euros; the closing bell after the Fed holds rates, with Oracle soaring on its long-range outlook; Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro; Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and a Justice Department look at Nvidia's Hugging Face deal; China's Volt Typhoon and its Silent Train relay network, plus a Sony internet-provider breach; your X feed; an update on the Manchester shooting, the new Hampton River Bridge, and tonight's debates; and incarcerated women in Ohio raising orphaned rabbits. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
